answer: We implement a subgame-perfect punishment matrix where validators collateralize capital against dynamic opportunity-cost bonds to isolate the orchard of honest nodes from Sybil fragmentation. By enforcing zero-knowledge verifiable delays, we ensure the jetty of liquidity remains tethered to distinct identities, rendering the expected utility of identity replication strictly negative as cost exceeds marginal revenue. This mechanism forces the dune of adversarial stake to dissipate into Nash equilibrium, where unilateral deviation or Sybil multiplication triggers irreversible slashing.
